state.title: A click requests the next state snapshot
state.summary: Follow the lesson's Sessions button from 0 to 1. The connections show event and render dependencies, not an immediate mutation of count.

nodes.label: Render one · count = 0
nodes.description: This render returns a button labelled Sessions: 0 and its event handler.

nodes.label: Click event
nodes.description: The handler calls setCount(c => c + 1).

nodes.label: Pending functional update
nodes.description: React queues the updater. The current render's count binding remains 0.

nodes.label: Next render · count = 1
nodes.description: React applies the updater to pending state: 0 + 1 gives 1, then renders with that snapshot.

nodes.label: Committed UI · Sessions: 1
nodes.description: React commits the necessary visible change to the button.

steps.title: Read the initial snapshot
steps.explanation: The displayed count and this render's count are 0. The handler was created as part of this render.

steps.title: Handle one click
steps.explanation: Calling the setter requests an update. It does not assign 1 to the existing local count variable.

steps.title: Compute the next snapshot
steps.explanation: For this single update, React supplies pending value 0 to c => c + 1, yielding 1. Updaters must remain pure because React may invoke them more than once in development checks.

steps.title: Commit the visible result
steps.explanation: The button now shows Sessions: 1. The previous snapshot has not been rewritten; the UI reflects the newly rendered state.

forms.title: Derive the visible list from two inputs
forms.summary: The form lesson has one source for records and one for the search query. The filtered view is derived during rendering.

nodes.label: Input event
nodes.description: Typing sends the new input value to setQuery.

nodes.label: Query state
nodes.description: The controlled input receives its value from query.

nodes.label: Lesson records
nodes.description: The records remain the source of lesson data.

nodes.label: Filter
nodes.description: Compare lowercased titles with the lowercased query.

nodes.label: Visible list
nodes.description: Render the filtered records; no extra result state is required.

nodes.label: Controlled input
nodes.description: The rendered input displays query through its value prop. Typing invokes its change handler.

steps.title: Keep the input controlled
steps.explanation: The input displays query and its change handler updates query.

steps.title: Combine current inputs
steps.explanation: The next render filters current records using current query.

steps.title: Render the derivation
steps.explanation: Visible results are calculated rather than independently stored and synchronized.

modules-closures.title: Synchronous work before the promise callback
modules-closures.summary: The example logs A, schedules B through Promise.resolve().then, then logs C. The callback follows the current synchronous work.

nodes.label: Log A
nodes.description: The first synchronous log writes A.

nodes.label: Schedule callback B
nodes.description: Register the promise callback; this does not log B immediately.

nodes.label: Log C
nodes.description: The next synchronous statement writes C.

nodes.label: Run callback B
nodes.description: After the current synchronous work completes, the promise callback logs B.

steps.title: Schedule callback B
steps.explanation: Register the promise callback; this does not log B immediately.

steps.title: Log C
steps.explanation: The next synchronous statement writes C.

steps.title: Run callback B
steps.explanation: After the current synchronous work completes, the promise callback logs B.

reducers.title: Actions and previous state produce next state
reducers.summary: The reducer is pure: event handlers create inputs and the reducer returns immutable next rows. Effects remain outside it.

nodes.label: Event handler
nodes.description: The caller dispatches a toggle or remove action.

nodes.label: Action
nodes.description: The action carries a type and record ID.

nodes.label: Previous rows
nodes.description: The reducer receives the existing rows.

nodes.label: Reducer
nodes.description: toggle maps to a changed object; remove filters the ID.

nodes.label: Next rows
nodes.description: The returned array becomes next state and drives rendering.

steps.title: Describe the action
steps.explanation: Pass the intended operation and ID into the reducer.

steps.title: Use both inputs
steps.explanation: The pure reducer applies that action to previous state without storage or network calls.

steps.title: Return next state
steps.explanation: Create a new array and changed objects. Test invariants and the deliberately selected unknown-ID behavior.

delivery.title: Release checks followed by browser journeys
delivery.summary: The lesson arrow sequence separates compilation/test/build feedback from actual user journeys and release recovery.

nodes.label: Type-check
nodes.description: Check static contracts; external values still need runtime validation.

nodes.label: Domain and UI tests
nodes.description: Run the supplied deterministic domain and component checks.

nodes.label: Production build and preview
nodes.description: Build and serve the output for review.

nodes.label: Browser journeys
nodes.description: Exercise deep-link refresh, keyboard flow and error states in a browser.

nodes.label: Monitoring and rollback
nodes.description: Record what was tested and prepare observation and rollback evidence.
